_about: Where each approved tune's phrases (and sub-phrases) end: the tick (12 per quarter, from the first note) just after the landing note. Read by tools/build_songbook.py into each record as phrases: [...]; musicfx.js cutAtPhrase cuts the Catch hook (8 s) and the Dig opening (2.6 s) at the last one that fits. Counted from the first note, so a pickup is already inside. Every end must fall between two notes. Jay, ancient-19, for Kai's review (cut_points.md).
